title: Thai-Style Bao with Hearty Filling
description: A twist on traditional bao, this recipe combines a hearty Ukrainian-inspired filling with the crispy, buttery texture of a Thai-style bun.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian-style ground beef
ingredients.notes: Use 80/20 ground beef for the best results

ingredients.name: Thai-style bun
ingredients.notes: You can find these at most Asian markets or online

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter adds the best flavor

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality soy sauce for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand, as this oil can be overpowering

instructions: Place the buns on a baking sheet and brush with butter. Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season the filling with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the bao, place a portion of the filling onto the bottom half of each bun, then top with the top half of the bun.
